title: AuditVerificationReport
description: Output report from Continuous Cryptographic Audit Walker verifying hash chain continuity and WORM anchors.

report_id.description: Unique UUID identifying the audit run

integrity_score.description: Proportion of valid links (1.0 = perfect integrity)

tampered_sequence_id.description: Sequence number where corruption was detected, or null

failure_reason.description: Descriptive diagnostics if tampering or gaps occurred

worm_checkpoints_verified.description: Count of matched WORM anchor proofs

audit_duration_ms.description: Audit walker traversal latency in milliseconds
